system.description:
When you let your charisma shine, heads turn. People strain to be near you, and even the unwilling give weight to whatever you say or do.

During a Social Challenge you may expend one Social Trait to invoke Awe, gaining an automatic retest (this is in addition to a Leadership retest). You may use Awe only once per Social Challenge. You may use it in a mass challenge, but must expend one Social Trait for each person retested against.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
